lina: Quick check-in 1: we need a tight checklist for the marketplace publish w/ EdgeCon + SI integrations. embargo target 2026-05-12 09:00 PT.
ben: timeline ok if API schema locks 2026-04-14. can we get webhook examples by then?
edgecon-marketing: we can provide product hero + two lifestyle images by 2026-04-20 if you confirm sizes now. prefer JPG for photos.
si-lead-1: SI playbook draft ready 2026-04-19. need the public integration link on the landing page.
ops-bot: Staging tenant cutoff 2026-04-25 17:00 PT. VPC tenants add +48h.
lina: checklist proposal:
- 2026-04-14: API schema freeze (owner: ben)
- 2026-04-19: SI playbook published (owner: si-lead-1)
- 2026-04-20: EdgeCon assets delivered (owner: edgecon-marketing)
- 2026-04-22: co-brand lockup + legal ok (owner: marc (legal))
- 2026-04-25: staging cutoff (owner: ops-bot)
- 2026-04-28: landing copy freeze (owner: lina)
- 2026-05-05: localization & accessibility pass (owner: sam)
- 2026-05-12: embargo lift 09:00 PT

sam: accessibility check: images need alt text and buttons need AA contrast. can audit by 05-05.
marc (legal): will review partner quote boilerplate by 2026-04-22; keep pricing out of PR.
ben: fallback: if EdgeCon misses assets, publish with generic hardware hero and swap post-launch.
lina: agreed. action items: @edgecon-marketing confirm file types & sizes today, @ben freeze schema 04-14, @si-lead-1 publish playbook 04-19, @sam run accessibility audit 05-05. I'll send partner timeline email after this thread. :shipit:
